primary: Exploratory all-request mean completion flow from external arrival, two run-level contrasts 1vs0 and2vs3. Retain throughput, TTFT, completion distributions, per-request maximum output gaps, failures/unfinished, actual output and EOS differences; no significance or equal-work claim. No new SLO threshold.
slo: No application SLO. Inherited20point frontier is diagnostic only.
hypothesis: Action-value probe, not a proposed optimized policy: on the first eligible ordinary native suffix with a distinct qualified candidate holding exactly the tail held pages and computed complete pages, request only the nearest preceding suffix index once. All other selections stay tail. The tail comparator records the same one-shot shadow opportunity. No host field, past recovery count, future EOS or output ranking is used. Shared recovery/trigger/quantum/transfers/admission remain fixed.
claim_ceiling: Independent trajectories with same external inputs and policy prefix, not snapshots or strict same-state counterfactuals. Report prefix/state differences and actual free-block deltas; same held pages alone are not proof of equal released capacity. Only one ABBA, two run-level pairs; no significance, quality-equivalence or independent-confirmation claim.
retention: Keep all existing host/cold/seeded failures and originals. New package, independent session and one finite ABBA only. No automatic restart or follow-up same-rule repetitions.
simple_comparators: Native tail is the original simple baseline; least-produced and original-arrival were shadow-identical on the observed normal-capacity burst. This is a bounded alternative-action probe, not a CacheOPT/UniBoost implementation or claimed novel ranking.

pilot_basis.semantics: Observed legal opportunity only; the online rule uses no fixed request IDs/step or future outcomes. Actual step/state may differ.

resource_handoff.scope: Only first GPU boundary before model preflight/CUDA. Original whole-group4800s budget includes this wait; later boundaries and every scientific setting unchanged. Unknown or busy state cannot initialize CUDA. No process signals and no automatic retry.

diagnostic_question: Does a single capacity-matched victim identity change alter complete service, without the extra released capacity and continuing tail retention of the retired host_near policy?
decision_rule: Maximum one ABBA (two paired runs). Require actual sole replacement and matched released pages; otherwise diagnose the concrete zero-action/capacity problem once, not expand the matrix. A positive full-service result motivates independent-prefix/load explanation; a negative, transferred-only or noise-sized result ends this single-burst probe without near-neighbor tuning or same-rule repetition. It does not reject all victim selection.
shared_budget_note: No expenditure telemetry or known remaining multi-session allowance. 4800s is a process ceiling, not a monetary budget estimate.
